```{r include=FALSE}
races_raw <- read_excel(here("data/race_results.xlsx"), sheet = 1) %>%
  clean_names()



hms_to_sec <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXct") || inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {
    hour(x) * 3600 + minute(x) * 60 + second(x)
  } else if (is.numeric(x)) {
    # raw Excel serial fraction of a day
    round(x * 86400)
  } else {
    period_to_seconds(hms(x))
  }
}

sec_to_clock <- function(s) {
  h <- s %/% 3600
  m <- (s %% 3600) %/% 60
  se <- round(s %% 60)
  ifelse(h > 0,
         sprintf("%d:%02d:%02d", h, m, se),
         sprintf("%d:%02d", m, se))
}
races <- races_raw %>%
  mutate(
    date = as_date(date),
    time_sec = hms_to_sec(time),
    pace_sec = hms_to_sec(per_mile_pace),
    time = sec_to_clock(time_sec),
    per_mile_pace = sec_to_clock(pace_sec),
    overall_pctl = 1 - (overall_rank - 1) / overall_total,
    group_pctl = 1 - (group_rank - 1) / group_total,
    distance_mi = case_when(
      str_detect(distance, "^5K")  ~ 3.107,
      str_detect(distance, "^10K") ~ 6.214,
      str_detect(distance, "Half") ~ 13.11,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)
```


```{r echo=FALSE}
tbl_data <- races |>
  mutate(
    overall = paste0(overall_rank, " / ", overall_total),
    group_rank_disp = paste0(group_rank, " / ", group_total),
    gender_rank_disp = paste0(gender_rank, " / ", gender_total),
    gender_pctl = 1 - (gender_rank - 1) / gender_total,
    overall_pctl_disp = scales::percent(overall_pctl, accuracy = 1),
    group_pctl_disp = scales::percent(group_pctl, accuracy = 1),
    gender_pctl_disp = scales::percent(gender_pctl, accuracy = 1)
  ) |>
  select(name, distance, date, location, time, per_mile_pace,
         overall, overall_pctl_disp,
         group, group_rank_disp, group_pctl_disp,
         gender_rank_disp, gender_pctl_disp,
         shoes, results_link, notes)
```



I picked up running in the summer following my first year as a way to destress while studying for my comprehensive exam. That same summer, I signed up for the Santa Monica 5k as a way to force myself to have a goal outside of passing my exam. Since then, I've run more races, partly to give me a goal outside of school, partly to stay healthy, and a huge part because I like collecting shiny medals and buying colorful shoes.

  bottom: 2rem;
  left: 0.65rem;
  width: 2px;

}
.race-timeline .race-year {

  margin: 0;

  left: calc(0.65rem + 1px);

  background: var(--race-accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--race-line);

```{r}
#| label: timeline-data
#| include: false

# Reuse the spreadsheet data and formatted times already prepared above.
# Optional spreadsheet columns: Photo, Photo Caption (or Photo Alt), GPX File, Story.
race_data <- as.data.frame(races)
if ("photo_caption" %in% names(race_data)) {
  if (!"photo_alt" %in% names(race_data)) race_data$photo_alt <- ""
  missing_alt <- is.na(race_data$photo_alt) | !nzchar(trimws(race_data$photo_alt))
  race_data$photo_alt[missing_alt] <- race_data$photo_caption[missing_alt]
}
for (column in c("location", "gpx_file", "story", "photo", "photo_alt", "results_link")) {
  if (!column %in% names(race_data)) race_data[[column]] <- ""
}
race_data$gpx_file <- trimws(as.character(race_data$gpx_file))
race_data$gpx_file[is.na(race_data$gpx_file)] <- ""
if (anyNA(race_data$date)) stop("Every race needs a valid date.")
race_data <- race_data[order(race_data$date), , drop = FALSE]
```

<!-- BEGIN ROUTE MAP DATA -->

```{r}
#| label: route-map-data
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(sf)
library(leaflet)

# Read each unique nonblank file once; the spreadsheet row picks its own map.
route_files <- unique(race_data$gpx_file[nzchar(race_data$gpx_file)])
route_shapes <- setNames(lapply(route_files, function(file) {
  path <- if (basename(file) == file) {
    here::here("data", "races", file)
  } else {
    here::here(file)
  }
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("GPX File not found: ", file,
                              ". Check the path in data/race_results.xlsx.")
  track <- sf::st_read(path, layer = "tracks", quiet = TRUE)
  track <- sf::st_transform(sf::st_zm(track, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM"), 4326)
  if (!nrow(track) || all(sf::st_is_empty(track))) stop("Empty GPX track: ", file)
  # Keep only geometry: timestamps and other GPX fields are not embedded.
  sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_geometry(track))
}), route_files)

race_route_map <- function(race) {
  if (!nzchar(race$gpx_file)) return(invisible(NULL))
  track <- route_shapes[[race$gpx_file]]
  if (is.null(track)) return(invisible(NULL))
  bounds <- sf::st_bbox(track)
  xy <- sf::st_coordinates(track)
  map <- leaflet::leaflet(
    track, width = "100%", height = 210,
    options = leaflet::leafletOptions(scrollWheelZoom = FALSE)
  ) |>
    leaflet::addTiles(options = leaflet::tileOptions(
      className = "minimal-basemap", opacity = 0.5
    )) |>
    leaflet::addPolylines(color = "#FC4C02", weight = 4, opacity = 1) |>
    leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
      lng = xy[1, "X"], lat = xy[1, "Y"], radius = 4,
      color = "#24476B", fillColor = "#FAFAF7", fillOpacity = 1,
      weight = 2, label = "Start"
    ) |>
    leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
      lng = xy[nrow(xy), "X"], lat = xy[nrow(xy), "Y"], radius = 4,
      color = "#24476B", fillColor = "#24476B", fillOpacity = 1,
      weight = 2, label = "Finish"
    ) |>
    leaflet::fitBounds(
      bounds[["xmin"]], bounds[["ymin"]], bounds[["xmax"]], bounds[["ymax"]],
      options = list(padding = c(12, 12))
    )
  # Register widget dependencies while printing inside the timeline's HTML loop.
  widget <- knitr::knit_print(map)
  knitr::knit_meta_add(attr(widget, "knit_meta"))
  cat('<div class="route-map" role="region" aria-label="',
      escape_html(paste("Route map for", race$name, race$distance)), '">\n', sep = "")
  cat(as.character(widget))
  cat('\n</div>\n')
}
```

```{r}
#| label: render-timeline
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Escape text so punctuation and spreadsheet text render safely as HTML.
escape_html <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub("'", "&#39;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
has_text <- function(x) !is.na(x) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
stat <- function(label, value) {
  if (!has_text(value)) return("")
  paste0("<div><dt>", escape_html(label), "</dt><dd>",
         escape_html(value), "</dd></div>")
}

cat('<div class="race-timeline">\n')
race_index <- 0L
years <- unique(format(race_data$date, "%Y"))
for (year in years) {
  cat('<section aria-labelledby="race-year-', year, '">\n',
      '<h3 class="race-year" id="race-year-', year, '">', year, '</h3>\n',
      '<ol class="race-list">\n', sep = "")
  entries <- race_data[format(race_data$date, "%Y") == year, , drop = FALSE]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(entries))) {
    race <- entries[i, , drop = FALSE]
    race_index <- race_index + 1L
    entry_class <- paste("race-entry",
                         if (race_index %% 2L == 0L) "is-reversed" else "",
                         if (!has_text(race$photo)) "no-photo" else "")
    cat('<li class="', entry_class, '"><article class="race-card">\n', sep = "")

    # No empty photo box is shown when photo is blank.
    if (has_text(race$photo)) {
      if (!has_text(race$photo_alt)) stop("Add Photo Caption or Photo Alt for: ", race$name)
      # Accept local relative paths only, keeping image assets in your project.
      if (grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:|\\\\)", race$photo)) {
        stop("Use a relative local photo path for: ", race$name)
      }
      # Accept paths written for either the website root or projects/ folder.
      photo_path <- trimws(race$photo)
      photo_candidates <- unique(c(photo_path, sub("^\\.\\./", "", photo_path),
                                   file.path("..", photo_path)))
      photo_candidates <- photo_candidates[file.exists(photo_candidates)]
      if (!length(photo_candidates)) stop("Photo not found: ", race$photo)
      photo_path <- photo_candidates[1]
      cat('<img class="race-photo" src="', escape_html(photo_path),
          '" alt="', escape_html(race$photo_alt), '" loading="lazy">\n', sep = "")
    }

    cat('<div class="race-card-body">\n',
        '<time class="race-date" datetime="', format(race$date, "%Y-%m-%d"), '">',
        format(race$date, "%B %d, %Y"), '</time>\n',
        '<h4 class="race-name">', escape_html(race$name), '</h4>\n', sep = "")
    if (has_text(race$location)) {
      cat('<p class="race-location">', escape_html(race$location), '</p>\n', sep = "")
    }
    cat('<dl class="race-stats">', stat("Distance", race$distance),
        stat("Finish", race$time), stat("Pace / mile", race$per_mile_pace), '</dl>\n', sep = "")
    race_route_map(race)
    if (has_text(race$story)) {
      cat('<p class="race-story">', escape_html(race$story), '</p>\n', sep = "")
    }
    if (has_text(race$results_link) && grepl("^https?://", race$results_link)) {
      cat('<a class="race-results-link" href="', escape_html(race$results_link),
          '">Official results <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>\n', sep = "")
    }
    cat('</div></article></li>\n')
  }
  cat('</ol></section>\n')
}
cat('</div>\n')
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Reveal each photo-and-text entry once per page load.
// Unobserving it after the first reveal keeps it visible when scrolling back.
(() => {
  const initRaceReveal = () => {
    if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window) ||
        window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;

    const entries = document.querySelectorAll(".race-timeline .race-entry");
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((changes) => {
      changes.forEach(({ target, isIntersecting }) => {
        if (!isIntersecting) return;
        target.classList.add("is-visible");
        observer.unobserve(target);
      });
    // Start farther into the viewport, rather than at its bottom edge.
    }, { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: "0px 0px -15% 0px" });

    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      entry.classList.add("reveal-pending");
      // Keep anything above a restored scroll position readable, too.
      if (entry.getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= 0) {
        entry.classList.add("is-visible");
      } else {
        observer.observe(entry);
      }
      // Keyboard navigation should never land in an invisible panel.
      entry.addEventListener("focusin", () => {
        entry.classList.add("is-visible");
        observer.unobserve(entry);
      }, { once: true });
    });
  };
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initRaceReveal, { once: true });
  } else {
    initRaceReveal();
  }
})();
</script>
```
